layouts.name: Cadwell Park
layouts.description: Draft association of the supplied venue-level entry to the existing independently mapped full course at Cadwell Park. This venue has one supplied entry and one retained independent course, with a timing point on that course. Source trace distance 3505.4 m; supplied distance 3445 m. The association preserves the independent source geometry and remains provisional where corner configurations or historical distances differ.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap course and venue identity
sources.evidenceNote: Venue identity and trace coordinates come from the pinned OSM extract. The source identity identifies the facility; course configuration is provisional. No privately sourced coordinates enter the public database.

sources.title: Imagery review of a source-border paint-line artifact
sources.evidenceNote: Imagery supports the documented local vertex deletion. Retained coordinates and their original border rights are unchanged. Review-image identity and its rights are embedded in the layout.
